vote.rationale: Accounting is exact: the six actions (1800+150+600+90+120+240) sum to the 3000s bounded allocation, the ceiling rises by the same 3000 to 200630, and post-allocation projected charge (~200608s) keeps the existing ~22s headroom. Author cap 80->81 funds exactly one additional author. The 600s Grok first-code-review is separate from the preserved 600s GPT6 reservation (still gated on substantive Grok PASS) and the 600s host verification, so nothing is double-counted. The changed approach is substantive, not a retry: the nine BLOCKED failures are success-shaped fakes (static verification, zero-history defaults, print-only repair, constant reports), and a test-first pass driven by retained public-API counterexamples plus a source-backed reproducer targets that class directly; explicit headless shell permissions address the prior cancellation cause. The gate correction only decouples the source verdict from final acceptance; host/pilot smoke remains mandatory with no waiver, and incorrect source or fake pilot still blocks. Scope stays within approved plugin files with financial/network/wallet/proof paths excluded, and further passes require a new decision, keeping this within standing bounded-resource authority. No refund or retroactive acceptance is granted; the current candidate remains BLOCKED. Caveat: review file hash and contents were not independently verified since no tools were requested.
